name: Should I repair my porch or replace it entirely?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair my porch or replace it entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace your porch depends on the extent of the damage and its overall structural integrity. If damage is localized to a few boards or railings, repair is often the more cost-effective solution. However, if there is widespread rot, significant structural instability, or continuous issues, a full replacement might be safer and more durable in the long run. We can help assess your porch's condition and recommend the best approach during a consultation in your Boise-area home, considering factors like age and original construction quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair if damage is localized; replace if there's widespread rot, significant instability, or recurring issues.
